verdicts.reason: A keeps a strong headline and a clear CTA, but the CTA is jammed right against the end of the subhead, the pill row stops well short of the CTA's right edge so the right side looks ragged, and the legal line is tiny. In B the flavour pills are oversized and nearly touching, so they outweigh the smaller CTA and the headline. The Honey Rosemary pill runs almost to the right edge over the decorative circle, and the uneven gaps between the brand name, headline and subhead make the layout look improvised.
